summary: 新西兰考察船 Tangaroa 在罗斯海开展南极调查。船员和科学家克服冰海、风与昼夜节律的挑战，通过海底采样和影像发现异常生物，也用纪录片记录了科研船上的生活。

paragraphs.brief: 新西兰对国际极年的贡献是Tangaroa号船为在南极洲罗斯海进行研究而航行52天。
sentences: New Zealand’s contribution to International Polar Year was a 52-day voyage by the ship Tangaroa in order to conduct research in Antarctica’s Ross Sea.
新西兰对国际极年的贡献是Tangaroa号船为在南极洲罗斯海进行研究而航行52天。

Lead scientist Mary Livingston emphasises just what a multi-faceted expedition this was, bringing together zoologists, oceanographers, meteorologists and other scientists from the Ministry of Fisheries, the National Institute for Water and Atmospheric Research, the National Museum and various universities, to study life beneath the seas of Antarctica.
首席科学家玛丽·利文斯顿强调这次多面考察的本质，将来自渔业部、国家水和大气研究所、国家博物馆和各大学的动物学家、海洋学家、气象学家和其他科学家聚集在一起，研究南极海底的生活。
Competition for berths – the ship can carry 44 people, including 13 crew – was fierce.
争夺泊位的竞争―― 船可以载44人，包括13名船员―― 激烈。
Voyage leader Stu Hanchet says, ‘We could have filled the science positions four times over … we had so many people requesting a berth … We ended up with a really strong team.’
我们本可以四次填补科学职位...我们有这么多人要求停靠...我们最后有一个非常强大的团队。

paragraphs.brief: 利奇曼说，"你仍然不能击败看着窗外：“虽然舰长们使用各种高科技设备... 却没人能告诉你冰有多厚。”
sentences: It would be hard to overstate how hostile the Antarctic environment is for scientists.
南极环境对科学家来说是多么的敌意很难说得过高
The Tangaroa’s captain, Graham Leachman, explains that the Ross Sea is subject to katabatic winds* that sweep down off the Antarctic continent to create rough seas.
Tangaroa的船长Graham Leachman解释说，罗斯海受到卡塔巴海风的侵袭，* 横扫南极大陆以创造粗糙的海洋。
Another danger is the possibility of the ship colliding with floating ice.
另一个危险是，船只可能与浮冰碰撞。
‘Even though the ship’s officers use all sorts of high-tech equipment … none of it can tell you how thick the ice is,’ says Leachman, ‘and you still can’t beat looking out of the window.’
利奇曼说，"你仍然不能击败看着窗外：“虽然舰长们使用各种高科技设备... 却没人能告诉你冰有多厚。”
In the dark, he says, you can’t tell how thick the ice is, but if you can see its colour, it’s possible to estimate.
在黑暗中，他说，你分不清冰有多厚，但是如果你能看到它的颜色，估计是可能的。
This is why he prefers sailing in summer, when the hours of daylight in these high latitudes are longest, even though this plays tricks with his passengers’ body clocks.
这就是为什么他更喜欢在夏天航行，白天在这些高纬度的时间是最长的，尽管这玩弄了他的乘客的时钟。

paragraphs.brief: 对探险发现的情况的分析还在继续，但很可能发现了几个新物种，并发现了许多其他秘密，大约在海面下3000米处。
sentences: Analysis of what the expedition found continues, but it’s likely that several new species have been discovered and numerous other secrets revealed about life 3,000 metres below the surface.
对探险发现的情况的分析还在继续，但很可能发现了几个新物种，并发现了许多其他秘密，大约在海面下3000米处。

‘We have collected huge worms and strange crustaceans,’ says Livingston, ‘but most impressive of all were the starfish that measured more than half a metre across – that’s most abnormal for creatures belonging to this species.’
“我们收集了巨大的虫子和奇怪的甲壳类动物，”Livingston说，“但最令人印象深刻的是测量了半米以上的海星 — — 这对属于这一物种的生物来说是最不正常的。
This phenomenon of Antarctic seas is called ‘gigantism’ – the fact that some species grow to unusually large sizes.
南极海洋的这个现象被称为“大亨主义”，即某些物种长到异常大的规模。
Livingston suggests various possible causes for gigantism including the extreme cold, few predators and high levels of oxygen in the seawater, but as yet no final determination can be made.
Liveston指出，可能存在各种导致摇头丸的原因，包括极端寒冷、很少捕食者、海水中的氧气含量高，但目前还无法作出最后决定。

Another interesting discovery was that in some places every inch of the sea floor was covered with life, whereas elsewhere icebergs have scoured out deep scars and ravines in the sea floor as they go by.
另一个有趣的发现是，在某些地方，每寸海底都覆盖着生命，而在另一些地方，冰山在经过的海底中挖出了深处的疤痕和峡谷。

paragraphs.brief: 通过使用深海拖网、高清晰度照相机和水采样器，小组发现，许多生活在极端深度的生物外观怪异。
sentences: By using deep-sea trawl nets, high-definition cameras and water samplers, the team has revealed that many of the creatures that live at extreme depths have a bizarre appearance.
通过使用深海拖网、高清晰度照相机和水采样器，小组发现，许多生活在极端深度的生物外观怪异。
Among them were spotted tunicates, plankton-eating animals that are slender structures that appear to be fashioned from glass.
其中有发现的外壳浮游生物食用微缩结构似乎是玻璃形成的
The most fearsome-looking fish was the Southern Ocean daggertooth, a species that is ‘monocyclic’, meaning the fish die after the first spawning.
最可怕的鱼是南大洋的匕首牙一种“单环型”的物种意思是鱼在第一次产卵后死亡
They are also unusual for being capable of shedding their teeth and growing a new set.
它们也不寻常，因为能够脱下牙齿，种植新的品种。
Another predatory fish brought to the surface was the stareater, an extraordinary species that has an appendage like a piece of cord hanging from its chin.
另一条捕食性鱼类被带到地表是一只凝视器一种非凡的物种其附着物就像一条绳索挂在下巴上
In these deep, dark waters, this glows red and attracts prey to swim within striking distance.
在这片深暗的水域里，红色的发光，吸引猎物在触目惊心的距离内游泳。
Just as impressive and much more beautiful were the basket stars, a species related to starfish that lives on the seabed.
篮子恒星同样令人印象深刻，也更加美丽，与海星有关的物种生活在海底。
The basket stars’ five arms branch out numerous times to form a spectacular fan-like structure which they turn to face into the current so that food is brought into their embrace.
篮子星的五臂形形形形色色形成了一个壮观的粉丝结构面对着潮流食物被拥抱

paragraphs.brief: 但是无论有什么令人兴奋的发现罗斯海的船上的日常生活都是无情的
sentences: But whatever exciting discoveries were made, everyday life onboard ship in the Ross Sea is unrelenting.
但是无论有什么令人兴奋的发现罗斯海的船上的日常生活都是无情的
Most people share a cabin with one other person – they’re allocated so that as one person begins their 12 hours off duty, the other occupant is starting work on deck.
大部分人和另外一个人共用一间小屋，他们被分配到这样的位置：当一个人开始12个小时的休假时，另一个住客就开始在甲板上工作了。
The fresh food runs out in a few days and after that most provisions are frozen, canned or dried.
几天后新鲜食物就会用完之后大部分食物都冷冻罐头或干燥
Expedition general manager Fred Smits recognises that the cook has an essential role in ensuring the well-being of those onboard.
探险总经理Fred Smits承认厨师在确保船上人员的福利方面发挥着至关重要的作用。
‘When you are at sea for so long,’ he says, ‘you think a lot about your next meal.’
他说，"你思考了很多关于你的下顿饭：“当你在海上那么久。”

paragraphs.brief: Livingston表示：「科学比人们意识到的还要勇敢。
sentences: Perhaps most controversially, one of the precious berths on the Tangaroa was taken up by cameraman Max Quinn, who filmed a documentary about the voyage.
也许最有争议的是坦噶罗亚号上的宝贵泊位之一被摄影师Max Quinn拿走了他拍摄了一部关于这次航行的纪录片
Quinn’s inclusion wasn’t welcomed at first.
Quinn的加入一开始并不受欢迎。
‘Scientists by nature,’ Livingston says, ‘tend to be camera-shy and quiet.
"自然界的科学家，"利文斯顿说，" 最终是摄像头和安静的。
They’re not into having cameras there, so it was difficult getting everyone’s permission and agreement.’
他们不喜欢在那里有摄像头，所以很难得到大家的许可和同意。"
But in the end Quinn fitted in very well.
但最后Quinn的装配还不错
‘The trick,’ he says, ‘is to mostly film the scientists at work, in their professional roles … rather than eating their breakfast.’
他说，"诡计，"是"大部分拍摄科学家的工作，以他们的专业角色... 而不是吃他们的早餐。"
He knows when not to intrude.
他知道什么时候不打扰你
The documentary is a window on a trip few people get to make and also a peek into what research really looks like.
记录片是少数人去旅行的窗口，也观看了研究的真实面目。
‘Science,’ says Livingston, ‘is intrepid, more so than people realise.
Livingston表示：「科学比人们意识到的还要勇敢。
It’s not necessarily examining dry samples in the laboratory, but can also mean braving the elements on deck.
它不一定是在实验室检查干样，但也可能意味着在甲板上涂抹元素。
That’s what the documentary captures, the sense of real people with real lives.’
这就是纪录片所捕捉的，真实人与真实生活的感觉。"

items.en: details of some equipment used by the scientists
items.zh: 科学家使用的一些设备的细节
items.why: 题干的 details of some equipment 与本句逐一列出设备完全对应。B段虽提到“high-tech equipment”,但未给出设备细节，故排除。

items.en: a description of the challenging sailing conditions in Antarctica
items.zh: 关于南极洲具有挑战性的航行条件的说明
items.why: 航行风险被多角度描述 (风、浪、冰、能见度、季节)。C/D/E/F段不以“航行条件” 为核心，故排除。

items.en: information about the composition of the scientific group
items.zh: 关于科学组组成的资料
items.why: composition of the scientific group =“来自哪些学科与机构的人”。其余段落未系统交代“队伍构成”。

items.en: the identity of a potentially unpopular person on the ship
items.zh: 船上可能不受欢迎的人的身份
items.why: 摄像师马克斯·奎因占用了宝贵船位引发争议，文中接着说明起初并不受欢迎。

items.en: The expedition’s findings Analysis continues of the expedition’s remarkable discoveries, including a ________, very notable for its unusual width.
items.zh: 研究者仍在分析这次考察取得的发现，其中有一只________，其宽度之大格外引人注目。
items.why: 文中用“across (直径/宽度) ”= 对应题干“unusual width”。写作 starfish (单词),符合 ONE WORD。

items.en: The reasons why creatures grow so large at great depths in Antarctica may include the highly oxygenated water, the temperature, or the small number of ________.
items.zh: 南极深海生物体型巨大，可能与水中含氧量高、温度或________数量很少有关。
items.why: 回到对应内容“Liveston指出，可能存在各种导致摇头丸的原因，包括极端寒冷、很少捕食者、海水中的氧气含量高，但目前还无法作出最后决定”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: A further fascinating finding was the existence of canyons in the seabed caused by passing ________.
items.zh: 另一项引人入胜的发现是，海底有一些由________经过时形成的峡谷。
items.why: 回到对应内容“另一个有趣的发现是，在某些地方，每寸海底都覆盖着生命，而在另一些地方，冰山在经过的海底中挖出了深处的疤痕和峡谷”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: Many creatures living at great depth look very strange, such as tunicates, which seem to be made of ________.
items.zh: 许多深海生物外形奇特，例如海鞘，看起来像是由________做成的。
items.why: 回到对应内容“其中有发现的外壳浮游生物食用微缩结构似乎是玻璃形成的”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: One frightening-looking fish species is characterised by loss of its ________ and the fact that it spawns only once.
items.zh: 有一种样貌可怕的鱼，会失去自己的________，一生也只产卵一次。
items.why: 回到对应内容“它们也不寻常，因为能够脱下牙齿，种植新的品种”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: Another fish has something like a length of string attached to its ________ that assists with hunting.
items.zh: 另一种鱼的________上连着一条细绳状的东西，有助于捕食。
items.why: 回到对应内容“另一条捕食性鱼类被带到地表是一只凝视器一种非凡的物种其附着物就像一条绳索挂在下巴上”，再按题干要求写出答案。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

items.answer: F · The nature of scientific work may surprise some people.
items.solution: 科学工作的性质可能会令一些人吃惊。

items.answer: G · More applications to join the group were received than there were places.
items.solution: 收到的加入该团体的申请比有的多。

items.answer: B · Respecting your subjects’ privacy gets the best results.
items.solution: 尊重学生隐私会得到最佳结果。

pairs: 帮助捕猎，具体作用是吸引猎物
points: 题干的 details of some equipment 与本句逐一列出设备完全对应。B段虽提到“high-tech equipment”,但未给出设备细节，故排除。
回到对应内容“另一个有趣的发现是，在某些地方，每寸海底都覆盖着生命，而在另一些地方，冰山在经过的海底中挖出了深处的疤痕和峡谷”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: The Tangaroa’s captain, Graham Leachman, explains … * that sweep down off the Antarctic continent to create rough seas.
“that the Ross Sea is subject to katabatic winds”补足 explains 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 explains 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
‘ … … none of it can tell you how thick the ice is,’ says Leachman, ‘and you still can’t beat looking out of the window.’
连接词 though 引出“Even though the ship’s officers use all sorts of high-tech equipment”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 though 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: Thirteen nations took part in the recent International Polar Year
13个国家参加了最近的国际极地年
